title: EUR/USD slides to ~1.1225 on French debt worries and Spanish politics
summary: EUR/USD lost about 0.3% to around 1.1225, extending the fall from the ~1.1700 August high. A strong German industrial production print (+2% m/m) failed to lift the euro.
ict: Rate differential: the Fed at 3.75–4.00% versus the ECB at 2.00% favours the dollar (money seeks yield). ICT would look for retracements into bearish order blocks or FVGs in premium, aimed at sell stops below recent lows.
